newsitem.title: USA: CIBCR leading U.S. inflation index 103.8 in Oct.
newsitem.headline: CIBCR leading U.S. inflation index 103.8 in Oct.

text.p: The Center for International Business Cycle Research (CIBCR) leading U.S. inflation index fell to 103.8 in October from a revised reading of 104.7 in September.

The growth rate of CIBCR's index of industrial materials prices, negative for the fourteenth consecutive month, fell strongly in October, as did the percentage of purchasing managers reporting higher prices.
The CIBCR is affiliated with Columbia University.
